get.summary:
Begin the password reset process for a user.
This will send out a password reset email to the user.

parameters.name: userName
parameters.description: The username associated with the user

post.summary: Complete the password reset process for a user.
Authenticates a user based on the provided login request.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: A login request model containing the username and password of the user.

200.description: A model containing the result of the login attempt and the token, if successful.

post.summary: Authenticates a user based on the provided login request.

get.summary: Get onboarding data including user info, current step, required agreements, and available subscriptions.

200.description:
OnboardingDataModel containing user profile fields, OnboardingRequired,
OnboardingState, any required agreements, and placeholder subscriptions.

get.summary:
Request an email authentication code for the user. 
This will send the user an email with the authentication code.

200.description: RequestEmailCodeResponse with the nonce for the email authentication code.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Contains the new password.

200.description:
SetPasswordResponse with success flag and error code. Returns
InvalidStepOrder if the current OnboardingState does not allow this step.

post.summary: Step 2: Configure Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) using an authenticator app.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Contains the Base32-encoded secret for authenticator-based MFA.

200.description:
SetupMfaResponse with success flag, recovery codes on success, and error code.
Returns InvalidStepOrder if the current OnboardingState is not MultiFactorAuth.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Subscription selection payload (currently a placeholder).

200.description:
CreateSubscriptionResponse with success flag and error code. Returns
InvalidStepOrder if the current OnboardingState is not Subscription.

post.summary: Step 4: Sign all required user agreements and finalize onboarding.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Agreement signing payload including agreement IDs and user address info.

200.description:
SignAgreementsResponse with success flag and error code. On success, onboarding is
finalized, any previous sessions are revoked, a new session is created, and an AuthToken is returned.
Returns InvalidStepOrder if the current OnboardingState is not Agreements.

delete.summary: Cancels all open orders for an account.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The ID of the account.

200.description: A boolean that is true if the operation was successful; otherwise, false.

delete.summary: Cancels all open orders on a symbol for an account.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The ID of the account.

parameters.name: symbolId
parameters.description: The ID of the symbol.

200.description: A boolean value indicating whether an order was cancelled.

parameters.name: accountId

parameters.name: contractId

parameters.description: The ID of the order.

parameters.description: The new personal daily loss limit. If null, the personal daily loss limit will be removed.

post.summary: Follows the trades made by another account.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: A request object containing the ID of the leader's account, the ID of the trading account, and the ratio for following.

200.description: A FollowTraderResponse indicating the success of the operation and any error message.

post.summary: Unfollows an account that is following another account and liquidates the account.

parameters.name: tradingAccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the account to unfollow on.

200.description: A FollowTraderResponse indicating the success or failure of the operation.

delete.summary: Clears all followers from an account.

parameters.name: tradingAccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the account from which followers should be removed.

200.description: A boolean value that indicates whether the operation was successful.

get.summary: Retrieves a list of following accounts for the current user.

200.description: A list of FollowTraderEntry representing the accounts that the current user has for following trades.

put.summary: Immediately stops all trading and liquidates the account. A "personal stop" violation will be added to the account for informational purposes.

AutoOcoBracketResponse.description: Represents a response from an AutoOcoBracket operation.

success.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

errorCode.description: The error code associated with the response.

errorMessage.description: The error message associated with the response, if any.

bracket.description: The AutoOcoBracket data if the operation was successful.

AutoOcoBracketErrorCode.description:
Specifies the error codes for AutoOcoBracket operations.

0 = Success
1 = Unauthorized
2 = InvalidStopLossTicks
3 = InvalidTakeProfitTicks
4 = InvalidStopLossType
5 = InvalidTakeProfitType
6 = BracketAlreadyExists
7 = NoBracketOrdersProvided
8 = UnknownError
9 = InvalidName
10 = NameAlreadyExists

AutoOcoBracketRequest.description: Represents a request to create or update an AutoOcoBracket.

id.description: The auto-oco bracket ID, if it already exists. If null, a new bracket will be created.

name.description: The name of the bracket. Must be unique per user and environment.

stopLossValue.description: The number of ticks for the stop loss order. Must be null or greater than 0.

takeProfitValue.description: The number of ticks for the take profit order. Must be null or greater than 0.

stopLossType.description: The type of order for the stop loss. Can only be Stop or TrailingStop.

takeProfitType.description: The type of order for the take profit. Can only be Limit.

stopLossValueType.description: The stop loss value type (ex: tick, dollar, etc...)

takeProfitValueType.description: The take profit value type (ex: tick, dollar, etc...)

AutoOcoBracketRemoveResponse.description: Represents a response from an AutoOcoBracket removal operation.

success.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

errorCode.description: The error code associated with the response.

errorMessage.description: The error message associated with the response, if any.

removedBracketId.description: The ID of the bracket that was removed.

AutoOcoBracketRemoveErrorCode.description:
Specifies the error codes for AutoOcoBracket removal operations.

0 = Success
1 = Unauthorized
2 = BracketNotFound
3 = BracketAlreadyDeleted
4 = UnknownError

AutoOcoBracketRemoveRequest.description: Represents a request to remove an AutoOcoBracket.

bracketId.description: The ID of the bracket to remove.

productId.description: This is the contract's parent product ID

productName.description: This is the contract's parent product name (ex: ES, NQ, CL, etc)

contractName.description: This is the contract's name (ex: ESU21, NQU21, CLU21, etc)

tickValue.description: This is the contract cost per 1 tick movement

tickSize.description: This is the minimum price movement for the contract

pointValue.description:
This is the value of a single point in the contract (TickValue / TickSize)
Used for calculating Profit and Loss (price difference * PointValue * Quantity)

exchangeFee.description: This is the exchange fee for the contract

regulatoryFee.description: This is the regulatory fee for the contract

commissionFee.description: This is the commission fee for the contract

totalFees.description: This is the total fees for the contract (ExchangeFee + RegulatoryFee + CommissionFee) for 1 contract

disabled.description: Whether the contract is disabled globally or not

decimalPlaces.description: Number of decimal places for the contract's price

priceScale.description: This is the contract's price scale

minMove.description: Value used by charts to calculate the minimum tick movement

fractionalPrice.description: Whether the contract uses fractional pricing or not

minMove2.description: Value used by charts to calculate the minimum tick movement for fractional prices

isProfessional.description: Whether this contract is for a professional subscription

CreateUserApiKeyResponse.description: Represents a response to a request for creating a new user API key.

success.description: Indicates whether the API key creation was successful.

errorMessage.description: Contains an error message if the API key creation failed.

apiKey.description: The newly created API key, if the creation was successful.

RevokeUserApiKeyResponse.description: Represents a response to a request for revoking an existing user API key.

success.description: Indicates whether the API key revocation was successful.

errorMessage.description: Contains an error message if the API key revocation failed.

RevokeUserApiKeyRequest.description: Represents a request to revoke an existing user API key.

apiKey.description: The API key to be revoked.
